mapper.sql: CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_open_item f WHERE f.direction='AR' AND f.order_id=sales_order.id) THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(f.gross_amount)=COUNT(*) AND SUM(f.quantity)>=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity-cancelled_quantity),0) FROM sales_order_item WHERE sales_order_id=sales_order.id) AND SUM(f.settled_amount)>=SUM(f.gross_amount) THEN 'PAID' WHEN SUM(f.settled_amount)=0 THEN 'UNPAID' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_PAID' END FROM fin_open_item f WHERE f.direction='AR' AND f.order_id=sales_order.id) ELSE sales_order.payment_status END

CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_open_item f WHERE f.direction='AP' AND f.order_id=purchase_order.id) THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(f.gross_amount)=COUNT(*) AND SUM(f.quantity)>=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM purchase_order_item WHERE purchase_order_id=purchase_order.id) AND SUM(f.settled_amount)>=SUM(f.gross_amount) THEN 'PAID' WHEN SUM(f.settled_amount)=0 THEN 'UNPAID' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_PAID' END FROM fin_open_item f WHERE f.direction='AP' AND f.order_id=purchase_order.id) ELSE purchase_order.payment_status END
